title: Looking for Love, 1996

cover_image.note: Flat front cover of the standard edition; the same photograph (140414_69023.jpg) is on Kominek's own product page, cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0063/0315/4246/products/140414_69023.jpg.

description.main: Looking for Love, 1996 collects the black-and-white photographs Alec Soth made at 26, while working in a commercial photo lab in Minnesota: bars, singles parties, poker games and proms, sequenced as a record of his own beginning as a photographer. Kominek Books, Berlin, published it in 2012.
description.extended:
Alec Soth's Looking for Love, 1996 collects the black-and-white photographs he made at 26, before any of the work that made his name, and reads them as a record of a photographer's beginning as much as of the people in front of the camera.

In 1996 Soth was processing other people's film at a commercial lab in Minnesota, smuggling his own prints out of the building and spending his evenings in a bar. With a medium-format camera he photographed the places where strangers go hoping to meet someone: bars and poker games, singles parties, a man on the phone at a Psychic Friends Network booth, a prom king and queen in an empty auditorium. The last picture is Soth himself, sprawled in a rented tuxedo. In his introduction he writes that he imagined a stranger would one day fall in love with him. Kominek Books in Berlin published the series in 2012 as a 56-page hardcover with 43 duotone plates; a special edition of 50 signed copies came with a print.

Soth was born in Minneapolis in 1969 and is a member of Magnum Photos. This book predates Sleeping by the Mississippi (2004) and the MACK titles the library holds, from Songbook to A Pound of Pictures. The search for connection among strangers that runs through all of them is already the subject here.
description.artist_bio: Alec Soth (b. 1969, Minneapolis). Member of Magnum Photos since 2008; founder of Little Brown Mushroom. Books: Sleeping by the Mississippi (Steidl 2004), Niagara (Steidl 2006), Broken Manual (Steidl 2010), Songbook (MACK 2014), Gathered Leaves (MACK 2015), I Know How Furiously Your Heart Is Beating (MACK 2019), A Pound of Pictures (MACK 2022), Advice for Young Artists (MACK 2024).
description.exhibition_context: The series was shown at Kominek Gallery, Berlin, in 2012 alongside the book's release; TIME LightBox (Jeffrey Ladd) and L'Oeil de la Photographie reviewed the book in 2012-2014.

notes: Shelf: Mixed. Standard first edition, Kominek Books, Berlin, 2012; 56 pages, 43 duotone black-and-white images, 20 x 22.2 cm (publisher's spec). A special edition of 50 signed and numbered copies with a 20 x 22.2 cm archival ink print was issued alongside. Kominek's shop now lists only the special edition; the standard edition page is gone, so publisher_url points to the special-edition page, which carries the standard book's specs. edcat.net lists 2011 and 64 pages; publisher, OpenLibrary/DNB and dealers agree on 2012 and 56 pages.
